半岛家庭购物、日常品牌采购、购物加电影或娱乐。: Family shopping on the Peninsula, everyday brands, and a shopping trip combined with a film or entertainment.

门店、影院与餐厅时间不同；开车先确定目标店靠哪一侧，避免在不同停车区之间来回找路: Store, cinema and restaurant hours differ. Before driving, check which side is closest to your main destination to avoid backtracking between parking areas.

日常生活用品、亚洲风格餐饮与美妆、亲友室内半日逛。: Everyday essentials, Asian food and beauty options, and an indoor half-day visit with friends or family.

家庭日常采购、运动服饰、购物后吃饭或娱乐。: Everyday family shopping, sportswear, and a meal or entertainment after browsing.

社区采购、运动与书店、吃饭加电影。: Neighborhood errands, sports and books, and dinner with a film.
